spells.notes: First 공보처장관. Named on 1989-12-27 (보각) while sitting 문화공보부장관, together with 이어령 (문화부) and 조경식 (환경처), for the offices that 법률 제4183호 created with effect from 1990-01-03 (부칙 제1조 단서, 공보처직제 대통령령 제12898호). The papers of 1989-12-28 expected the 임명장 on 12-28, but 경향신문 (1990-01-03), 중앙일보 (1990-01-03), 한국일보 and 세계일보 (1990-01-04) report that the 임명장 for the three new offices were handed over on the morning of 1990-01-03, so start is the day the office opened. His 문화공보부장관 spell (culture lineage) runs to 1990-01-02. Because 공보처 was a new office and this lineage starts with him, reorg_continuation is false. Left on 1990-12-27 when he was appointed 노동부장관 in the 12·27 개각 (end_reason other = moved to another cabinet post). ko.wikipedia gives 1989-12-28 ~ 1990-12-20, which the day-of reports do not support. Birth date from the NA record (_rebuild/na_members/na_members_12_22.csv) and ko.wikipedia '최병렬 (정치인)'. News Library OCR passages were cross-checked against the typed BigKinds texts of other papers for the same events.

On 1992-06-05 the 청와대 announced that he would become 민자당 대표최고위원(김영삼) 비서실장 and that 손주환 would succeed him, both with effect from 1992-06-08 (8일자). issues.desc: No official 역대 장관 list exists for the 1990-1998 공보처 (the mcst 공보처 tab is the 1948-1956 office, per SOURCES_TOOLKIT.md), so the holder list rests on ko.wikipedia plus day-of news, and the dates on day-of news, 대통령기록관 schedules and the 국사편찬위원회 연표. ko.wikipedia '대한민국 공보처' (revid 41400921) differs from the day-of reports at every boundary. It gives 최병렬 1989-12-28 ~ 1990-12-20, 최창윤 1990-12-20 ~ 1992-06-06, 손주환 1992-06-06 ~ 1992-10-09, 류혁인 1992-10-09 ~ 1993-02-25 and 오인환 1993-02-26 ~ 1998-02-24. This file uses 1990-01-03 (임명장 for the new office), 1990-12-27 (12·27 개각, 임명장 that afternoon), 1992-06-08 (8일자 appointment, 이·취임식 06-08), 1992-10-09 (중립내각, 임명장 that afternoon) and 1993-02-26 (first 김영삼 cabinet, 임명장 that afternoon).

The 1998 holdover 오인환 (1993-02-26 ~ 1998-02-27) is copied unchanged from culture.verified.json with from_main true. His ministry value 공보처 is mapped to public_info through offices_1988.json ministry_to_lineage_overrides ('공보처 -> public_info'), which build_panel.py applies. Evidence found here agrees with the main record's start. 동아일보 1993-02-26 reports the announcement on the morning of 02-26 with the 임명장 that afternoon, and 동아일보 1993-02-27 shows him at his 취임식 on the afternoon of 02-26. Nothing found here contradicts the main record, so no high-severity issue is raised.

유혁인's end (1993-02-26) is inferred from the successor's appointment. The 현승종 cabinet did not resign collectively on 1993-02-24/25 (매일경제 1993-02-24 quotes the 총무처 view that ministers hand over when a successor is appointed), and other outgoing ministers held their 이임식 on 1993-02-26. No report of his own 이임식 was found.

최병렬 held 문화공보부장관 (culture lineage) until 1990-01-02 and was named 공보처장관 on 1989-12-27 while still in that post. Here his 공보처 spell starts 1990-01-03 with reorg_continuation false, because public_info has no predecessor spell. If the panel should treat his move from 문화공보부 to 공보처 as one continuous appointment across lineages, that link has to be made outside this file. The culture ext88 file should end his 문화공보부 spell on 1990-01-02.
